title: Candidate
description: ODIN's CANDIDATE record: the model's raw answer, unchanged, submitted to POST /log/agent before it is checked (CONTRACT.md v0.6 §8.3, §16.5 U17). reasoning_content is never the answer (§11.1), so it is never a candidate.

channel.description: CONTENT: the model's text, for spark. MESSAGE: for spark_open, the message that ends the turn, its content and its tool calls (§11.1 as amended 29 October 2026). TOOL_CALLS: spark_open's answer-tool calls alone, as written before that amendment, until Muse Code's M14 writes MESSAGE; no scored run has used it.

raw.description: CONTENT: that text, unchanged. MESSAGE: {"content": ..., "tool_calls": [...]} serialized as JSON, each exactly as returned, content null when the message has none. TOOL_CALLS: those calls serialized as JSON.
